newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filipino Fund to sell more shares.
newsitem.headline: Filipino Fund to sell more shares.

text.p: Closed-end mutual fund Filipino Fund Inc is offering 350 million shares to the public, fund manager BPI Investment Management Inc said on Wednesday.

BPI Investment told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Filipino Fund's board had agreed to sell 150 million shares to domestic investors, 100 million shares to foreign funds, and the remaining 100 million shares to its existing shareholders as of February 26.
The offering of new shares is to cover the increase in its authorised capital stock.
